officialTitle: Bevacizumab for newly diagnosed pleural mesothelioma in the Mesothelioma Avastin Cisplatin Pemetrexed Study (MAPS): a randomised, controlled, open-label, phase 3 trial

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: From Feb 13, 2008, to Jan 5, 2014, we randomly assigned 448 patients to treatment (223 [50%] to PCB and 225 [50%] to PC).
design.notes: Conducted at 73 hospitals in France; age 18-75, ECOG PS 0-2, no substantial cardiovascular comorbidity; stratified by histology (epithelioid vs sarcomatoid or mixed), PS, centre and smoking status.

clinicalQuestion: Does adding bevacizumab to cisplatin-pemetrexed improve overall survival in unresectable malignant pleural mesothelioma?

pico.population: Unresectable, chemotherapy-naive malignant pleural mesothelioma, age 18-75, ECOG PS 0-2, no substantial cardiovascular comorbidity

arms.label: PCB
arms.dosing: Pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 plus cisplatin 75 mg/m2 with bevacizumab 15 mg/kg in 21-day cycles for up to six cycles
arms.doseSourceQuote: to receive intravenously 500 mg/m(2) pemetrexed plus 75 mg/m(2) cisplatin with (PCB) or without (PC) 15 mg/kg bevacizumab in 21 day cycles for up to six cycles, until progression or toxic effects.

arms.label: PC
arms.dosing: Pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 plus cisplatin 75 mg/m2 in 21-day cycles for up to six cycles
arms.doseSourceQuote: to receive intravenously 500 mg/m(2) pemetrexed plus 75 mg/m(2) cisplatin with (PCB) or without (PC) 15 mg/kg bevacizumab in 21 day cycles for up to six cycles, until progression or toxic effects.

publications.title: Bevacizumab for newly diagnosed pleural mesothelioma in the Mesothelioma Avastin Cisplatin Pemetrexed Study (MAPS): a randomised, controlled, open-label, phase 3 trial.
publications.label: Primary analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: OS was significantly longer with PCB (median 18·8 months [95% CI 15·9-22·6]) than with PC (16·1 months [14·0-17·9]; hazard ratio 0·77 [0·62-0·95]; p=0·0167).

safety.sourceQuote: Overall, 158 (71%) of 222 patients given PCB and 139 (62%) of 224 patients given PC had grade 3-4 adverse events.
We noted more grade 3 or higher hypertension (51 [23%] of 222 vs 0) and thrombotic events (13 [6%] of 222 vs 2 [1%] of 224) with PCB than with PC.

strengths: Randomised phase III trial with OS as primary endpoint
limitations: Restrictive eligibility (age limit, no substantial cardiovascular comorbidity, no anticoagulation) limits generalisability
Bevacizumab added hypertension and thrombotic toxicity

clinicalImplications.text: Adding bevacizumab to cisplatin-pemetrexed prolonged OS in fit, selected patients with unresectable pleural mesothelioma, at the cost of manageable hypertension and thrombotic events.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Eligibility matters: patients with significant cardiovascular disease or on therapeutic anticoagulation were excluded.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 26719230.
